verification.summary: Passed 4/4 in 3.3 minutes with one worker and zero retries, on approval 2026-08-20-dispute-lifecycle-closure. Three independent USD 50.00 disputes were raised by the provider and carried through voluntary acceptance, winning evidence and losing evidence; the lock directory ended with zero quarantine receipts and zero unresolved provider write attempts. The on-hold transition this family had been blamed for missing is present in the order's own durable record - "Order status changed from Processing to On hold." sits directly under the dispute-created note - and the two readings that were never separated were both wrong. DP2 and DP3 assert the absence of an update effect as a tripwire; see the 2026-08-20 correction in FIDELITY-CLAIMS.md.

Retained rather than tidied away: two earlier runs failed at the shared creation step when the third disputed-card checkout stored the test card PAN appended to billing_phone, created no provider object and never reached its receipt, while the first two shoppers of the same runs were clean. The Playwright trace shows every card entry going into the provider iframe, so the driver is not typing in the wrong place; the corruption appears between the browser form state and the stored order. It is intermittent - it did not occur on the closing run or on three others - and the driver now refuses to submit a checkout whose phone field holds a card number, so a recurrence fails at the corruption instead of at a receipt that never arrives. Both PAN-carrying orders were deleted; their facts are recorded in the run's quarantine resolutions.
